implementationCommits.message: qa: bind facade weathering to physical sources
qa: verify weathering source catchments at render time

runRecordCommit: This file is committed immediately after headBeforeRunRecord; use branch history for its self-referential commit SHA.
problem: Existing facade weathering was generated from construction-aware sources, but persisted residue meshes were not independently proven to remain spatially attributable to those modeled sources at formal render time. A later mesh edit could therefore detach a stain from its physical cause while source-count and material QA still passed.

sourceCatchments: 210 modeled rail base fixings with deliberately sparse active oxide sources
grade/facade splash interface with a stronger upper envelope near concentrated downpipe discharge
enforcement: all persisted weathering vertices must resolve to a permitted physical-source catchment
all mandatory sources must retain minimum witness geometry
grade splash must preserve a measurable drainage-side height response
rail oxide runoff must remain sparse rather than activating every repeated fixing
MainCamera pre-cull validation is fail-closed in the benchmark scene
contract references canonical Visual Fidelity critical-defect IDs
lookdev is explicitly non-render evidence and cannot award points

manualRenderChecksWhenRunnerAppears: hero/facade_center and hero/facade_right: grade splash must decay upward and strengthen near drainage without reading as a horizontal painted band
100% window_sill_runoff crop: streaks must originate beneath plausible sill low points and remain gravity-aligned
100% balcony_drip_edge crop: drip residue must relate to the slab edge rather than float on the wall
100% rail_fixing_rust crop: oxide runoff must remain sparse, non-repeating and localized to actual fixings
100% ac_drain_termination crop: residue must remain a dry local deposit at the real hose termination
grazing/material_grazing: causal geometry must not create z-fighting, interpenetration or implausible glossy residue
nextBlocker: Unity 6000.3.0f1 Runner/runtime. On first real Runner/screenshots, stop speculative expansion, compile and execute the catchment QA, then render and review sealed native 4K evidence before assigning any Visual Fidelity points.
